system.notes:
Euphoria's limousine — one Knight Errant guard drives it. QE p.16 is explicit that "this particular Nightsky has no concealed weaponry."

Conversion: p.283 method A. This vehicle exists in SR2, so the module takes the system catalogue entry whole rather than carrying SR1 numbers across — the same call already made for Craft's Ares Predator. Ruled by futurekill 2026-08-03 for consistency with how every weapon in the module was converted. The ×3 vehicle-armour rule therefore does NOT apply here: the catalogue entry already prints SR2-scale armour, and doing both would double-count.

An armored executive limousine.

Cruising speed 45 m/CT (used for vehicle tests). Max speed 120 m/CT. Stats: SR2E p.264-265.

Stats verified against the Rigger 2 Vehicle List (SR2, book p.148+). Handling 4/8.
